permissions.purpose: Read balance transactions and their sources to summarize collected revenue and settlements. Rizly never creates or changes transactions.
Read charges and refunds to report successful, failed, and refunded payments. Rizly never creates charges or refunds.
Read customer records to attribute payment and subscription insights to the correct customer. Rizly never changes customer data.
Read invoices to identify paid, open, overdue, and failed billing activity. Rizly never creates or changes invoices.
Read payment intents to summarize payment status and failures. Rizly never confirms or changes payment intents.
Read subscriptions to calculate recurring revenue, new subscriptions, cancellations, and churn. Rizly never creates or changes subscriptions.
